A2 Tricks and Treats AoE single hit, DB multiplier 4.3 ATK

recipes.name: Panic Spread
covers: attacks 1 enemy (F_MADAME_A1)
20% [Fear] 1t (consumer: CC 50%-misfire)
deferred: [Fear] chance rises to 30% if the target is under 1 debuff, 45% if under 2 or more debuffs — dynamic chance scaling on target debuff-count not modelled (base 20% used)

recipes.name: Tricks and Treats
covers: attacks all enemies (F_MADAME_A2)
40% chance of stealing 1 random buff from each enemy (STEAL_BUFF)
deferred: places a [Block debuffs] buff on all allies 2t if any buff is stolen — [Block Debuffs] has no engine consumer (not in consumer registry); placing it would be inert

places a [True Fear] debuff 1t on enemies who have buffs stolen — conditional on a successful per-target buff-steal; there is no per-target 'buff_stolen' condition to gate it, and an independent 40% placement would over-credit guaranteed turn-denial CC onto enemies that had no buff to steal — deferred (needs op: per-target buff-stolen condition)

recipes.name: Midnight Ritual
covers: removes all buffs from all enemies (BUFF_STRIP — 'removes' = strip, not steal/place)
50% [Decrease ATK] 2t on all enemies (consumer: statFactor)
60% [Decrease DEF] 2t on all enemies (consumer: statFactor; boosts ATTACK damage only)
deferred: skill does not attack (text: 'Removes all buffs from enemies. Places…') and DB multiplier is null — no DEAL_DAMAGE row emitted
no per-debuff chance stated on the card — modelled as guaranteed placement (chance 1.0) still gated by the ACC-vs-RES accuracy_check

recipes.name: Witch's Grace [P]
covers: self [Shield] = 10% of caster MAX HP at the start of each turn (start_of_turn trigger; Shield consumed by engine)
35% [Fear] 1t on the attacker when attacked (attacked trigger; Fear CC 50%-misfire; effect rolls ACC vs RES)
deferred: the on-attacked [Fear] requires being under a [Shield] buff — the shield precondition is not gated in the trigger (no self_under_shield trigger variable); approximated as effectively always-satisfied because she self-applies [Shield] every start_of_turn

newOpsNeeded.why: Madame Serris A2 places [True Fear] 1t ONLY on enemies who had a buff successfully stolen this skill. No per-target 'buff was stolen this skill' condition exists to gate a PLACE_DEBUFF, so the guaranteed turn-denial CC cannot be modelled without over-crediting enemies that had no buff. Recurs for any 'steal-then-punish' kit.

notes:
Source of truth: step3-champions.json 'Madame Serris' (Void / Epic / Support / Dark Elves). Every clause of all 4 skills is either a modelled action or a deferred entry — nothing dropped.

A1 (cd0, 4.2 ATK): attack + 20% [Fear] 1t. The 20→30→45% escalation by target debuff-count is deferred (dynamic-chance; base 20% used). Fear is a live CC consumer (engine.js 50%-misfire).

A2 (cd4, 4.3 ATK): AoE attack + 40% STEAL_BUFF (1 random buff/enemy). Two riders deferred: [Block debuffs] on allies (inert — no consumer) and the conditional [True Fear] on enemies who had a buff stolen (no buff-stolen per-target condition; independent placement would over-credit guaranteed CC → flagged in newOpsNeeded).

A3 (cd6, multiplier null): NON-attacking utility — BUFF_STRIP all enemy buffs (removes = strip, policy #19), then 50% Decrease ATK + 60% Decrease DEF 2t AoE, both live consumers. No damage row (no 'Attacks' verb, null multiplier). No card chance % → modelled guaranteed (1.0) but still ACC-checked.

Passive: start_of_turn self [Shield] = 10% MaxHP (pctOfCasterMaxHp:0.10, dur 2 mirrors the HILVI-style self-shield), and attacked→35% [Fear] on attacker. The 'while under [Shield]' precondition on the Fear clause is approximated as always-true since she re-shields every turn start (deferred note); matches the Xenomorph/Pelops reactive-on-attacker passive shape.

Formulas F_MADAME_A1/A2 use DB multipliers verbatim (4.2 / 4.3 ATK, hitCount 1, terms:null, flags:{...DMG_FLAGS}). No multiplier fabricated; A3 has no formula. Champion name 'Madame Serris' used verbatim as the DB/registry name.

recipes.name: Axe of Glory
deferred: 'Attacks 1 enemy 2 times' — damage multiplier not in DB (multiplier + multiplierType both null); DEAL_DAMAGE omitted rather than fabricating a multiplier (no F_STALTUS_A1 created)

if the target is under ANY debuff, each of the 2 hits decreases the target's Turn Meter by 10% (−20% total) — REDUCE_TURN_METER is implemented but its handler ignores act.condition (would fire unconditionally = over-credit vs the 'target under a debuff' gate) AND no 'target_has_debuffs' condition kind exists (conditionMet supports only under_debuff (typed), tm_depleted, is_boss, target_has_buffs, under_buff, not_under_buff) — deferred pending a condition-gated REDUCE_TURN_METER + a target_has_debuffs condition kind

recipes.name: Drakehunter Tactics
covers: 50% [Stun] 1t on all enemies (Stun consumed by the engine as hard turn-denial CC)
deferred: 'Attacks all enemies 2 times' — damage multiplier not in DB (multiplier + multiplierType both null); DEAL_DAMAGE omitted rather than fabricating a multiplier (no F_STALTUS_A2 created)
each of the 2 hits rolls [Stun] independently at 50% (net ~75% land per enemy); modelled as ONE 50% PLACE_DEBUFF roll (DEACON-A1 / Hilvi-A1 precedent) — slightly understates net land chance

recipes.name: Dragon Heart
covers: 60% [Increase DEF] on self 3t placed before the attack (consumed by engine statFactor)
deferred: 'then attacks all enemies' — damage multiplier not in DB (multiplier + multiplierType both null); DEAL_DAMAGE omitted rather than fabricating a multiplier (no F_STALTUS_A3 created)

75% chance of 25% [Decrease C. DMG] 2t on enemies whose ATK > DEF — [Decrease C.DMG] has no engine consumer (not in STAT_MODS/CONSUMED_EFFECTS); placing it would be inert. (Also gated on the ATK>DEF stat comparison, which has no condition kind.)

75% chance of 30% [Decrease SPD] 2t on enemies whose ATK <= DEF — [Decrease Speed] IS a consumed debuff, but the placement is gated on a per-target ATK<=DEF stat comparison and no stat-comparison condition kind exists; placing it unconditionally would over-credit AND mis-apply against the enemies that reality routes to the [Decrease C.DMG] branch instead — deferred pending a stat_compare (ATK vs DEF) condition kind

recipes.name: Untarnished
deferred: whenever an enemy ATTEMPTS to place a [Weaken], [Decrease DEF], or [Poison] debuff on this Champion, reflects it back onto the attacker — no 'debuff placement attempt on self' reactive trigger event (supported: attacked, hit_taken, hp_below, start_of_turn, round_start, ally_death, enemy_frozen) and no reflect-debuff op — needs op: REFLECT_DEBUFF on a debuff_place_attempt_on_self trigger

this Champion's damage increases by 5% for each debuff on the target — no op/formula field scales attack damage by the target's debuff count (per-target debuff-count damage bonus); Staltus has no captured DB multiplier anyway, so nothing to scale — needs op: target-debuff-count damage bonus

newOpsNeeded.why: Staltus A1 decreases the target's Turn Meter by 10% per hit ONLY if the target is under any debuff. The REDUCE_TURN_METER OP_HANDLER ignores act.condition (fires unconditionally), and conditionMet has no 'target_has_debuffs' (any-debuff) kind — only typed under_debuff. Both are needed to gate this faithfully.

Staltus A3 splits its debuff per enemy by whether ATK > DEF ([Decrease C.DMG]) or ATK <= DEF ([Decrease SPD]). No stat-comparison condition kind exists to gate a per-target PLACE_DEBUFF, so the consumable [Decrease SPD] branch cannot be placed without over-crediting the enemies that should get the other branch.

Staltus A4 reflects incoming [Weaken]/[Decrease DEF]/[Poison] placement ATTEMPTS back onto the attacker. Neither the reactive trigger event (fires on an enemy's attempt to debuff self) nor a reflect-debuff op exists.
Staltus A4 increases his damage by 5% for each debuff on the target. No formula flag/field scales attack damage by the target's current debuff count.

notes: Force / Banner Lords / Defense Legendary. ALL FOUR skills have null DB damage multiplier AND null multiplierType, so per the ruleset (and the MORAG/LORD precedent) DEAL_DAMAGE is omitted on every attacking skill and the damage is deferred — no F_STALTUS_* formulas were fabricated (formulas[] empty). Modelled clauses: A2 [Stun] (consumed CC) and A3 self 60% [Increase DEF] (consumed). Deferred consumables/blockers: A1 conditional Turn-Meter drain (no condition-gated REDUCE_TURN_METER + no target_has_debuffs kind); A3 [Decrease SPD] (consumable but gated on an unsupported ATK<=DEF stat comparison — deferring avoids over-crediting the [Decrease C.DMG] branch enemies); A3 [Decrease C.DMG] (inert, no consumer); A4 reflect + per-debuff damage scaling (no trigger/op). Every clause of every skill is either an action or a deferred entry — nothing dropped. Cooldowns from DB: A1 0, A2 4, A3 5, A4 passive.

formulas.note: A1 Dark Sphere — DB damage_multiplier 2.8, multiplier_type ATK, AoE single-hit. selfHealPctOfDamage 0.20 covers the CASTER's share of "heals this Champion and all allies by 20% of the damage inflicted" (fires per enemy dealt across the AoE = 20% of total). The all-OTHER-allies share needs a new op (see deferred/newOpsNeeded).

recipes.name: Dark Sphere
covers: AoE attack (2.8 ATK)
heals the CASTER by 20% of the damage inflicted (selfHealPctOfDamage on F_BADELKAZAR_A1)
deferred: heals all OTHER allies by 20% of the damage inflicted — no team-heal-by-damage-dealt op; selfHealPctOfDamage covers the caster only. This is his primary sustain (load-bearing for a survival sim) → flagged in newOpsNeeded.

recipes.name: Malice
covers: removes all debuffs from all allies (CLEANSE, count omitted = all)
two 15% [Continuous Heal] on all allies 2t — modelled as one 30% [Continuous Heal] tick (see deferred)
two 5% [Poison] on all enemies 2t (target MAX HP, DEF-independent; stacking, maxStacks 10)
deferred: the two 15% [Continuous Heal] buffs are modelled as a SINGLE 30% [Continuous Heal] — the engine's upsert collapses same-type buffs into one, so total per-turn heal (30% of ally MaxHP) is preserved but the two independent buff instances/durations are not separately tracked

recipes.name: Prey Upon [P]
deferred: [P] "All allies inflict 20% more damage against targets under [Poison] debuffs" — a passive, team-wide, CONDITIONAL attack-side damage amplifier keyed on the target carrying [Poison]. Not a placed buff (no consumer-registry entry), not a supported trigger event. Synergises with his own A2 Poison. Needs a new op (see newOpsNeeded).

newOpsNeeded.why: Bad-el-Kazar A1 "Heals this Champion and all allies by 20% of the damage inflicted" — a team-wide heal scaled off the damage the skill deals. The existing selfHealPctOfDamage field heals the CASTER only; there is no op to heal ALL allies by a % of damage dealt. Recurs on damage-based team healers (e.g. Hordin-style). High value: this is Bad-el-Kazar's core CB sustain (memory: ~10.66M/135t sustain seat).

Bad-el-Kazar passive "Prey Upon" — all allies deal +20% damage against targets under [Poison]. A passive, team-wide, conditional attack-side damage multiplier keyed on a debuff being present on the TARGET (the attacker-side, all-allies mirror of [Poison Sensitivity], which is defender-side). No current op or consumer models a passive attack-damage bonus gated on a target debuff.

notes:
Source of truth: step3-champions.json entry "Bad-el-Kazar" (Force / Legendary / Support / Undead Hordes). All values transcribed verbatim; no multipliers fabricated.

Per-skill decomposition (every clause -> action or deferred, nothing dropped):
- A1 Dark Sphere (cd0, mult 2.8 ATK): [1] AoE attack -> ACQUIRE_TARGETS all_enemies + DEAL_DAMAGE. [2] "heals this Champion...by 20% of damage inflicted" -> selfHealPctOfDamage 0.20 on the formula (caster share, MODELLED). [3] "...and all allies by 20%..." -> DEFERRED (needs HEAL_ALLIES_PCT_OF_DAMAGE).
- A2 Malice (cd5, no attack, mult null): [1] "Removes all debuffs from all allies" -> CLEANSE all_allies. [2] "two 15% [Continuous Heal] on all allies 2t" -> PLACE_BUFF Continuous Heal (in consumer registry; two stacks combined into one 30% tick because upsert collapses same-type buffs — documented in deferred). [3] "two 5% [Poison] on all enemies 2t" -> ACQUIRE_TARGETS all_enemies + PLACE_DEBUFF Poison pct 0.05 count 2, stacking maxStacks 10, accuracy_check true (guaranteed placement — no stated chance -> chance omitted). Poison scales off TARGET MaxHP, DEF-independent (honoured).
- Passive Prey Upon [P]: team-wide +20% damage vs poisoned targets -> fully DEFERRED (needs TEAM_DAMAGE_AMP_VS_DEBUFF).

Two real op gaps flagged; both are Bad-el-Kazar's headline mechanics (damage-based team heal + the Poison damage-amp passive), so authoring him is a decomposition record until those ops exist. Consumer-registry compliance verified: Continuous Heal and Poison are both consumed; nothing inert was placed. recipeKey BAD-EL-KAZAR confirmed via champKey (split on space -> 'Bad-el-Kazar' -> uppercased)."

recipes.name: Scepter of Authority
covers: attack (4x ATK, 1 hit)
50% Decrease ATK 2t @35%

recipes.name: Necro Mutation
covers: heals all allies 20% of caster MAX HP
deferred: After healing, places [Perfect Veil] 2t on all allies AT FULL HP, and a 15% [Continuous Heal] 1t INSTEAD on all allies below 100% HP — both effects are valid engine consumers, but the split is per-ally by post-heal HP fraction and there is no HP-conditional ally target/branch for PLACE_BUFF (placing either on all_allies would over-credit the wrong allies)

recipes.name: Spirit Form
covers: revives a single ally at 60% HP + fills their Turn Meter by 60% (REVIVE tmPct)
deferred: places a [Perfect Veil] buff on the single revived ally for 3 turns — no recipient enum resolves to the just-revived ally (same gap already deferred on other revive-then-buff-on-revived-ally recipes); [Perfect Veil] itself is a consumer, only the targeting is unsupported

recipes.name: Master of Ghosts [P]
deferred: Whenever an ally under a [Veil] or [Perfect Veil] buff gets a turn, heals THAT ally by 10% of ITS OWN MAX HP — needs a cross-ally start-of-turn trigger gated on the moving ally being veiled, plus a heal scaled off the TARGET ally's MAX HP (HEAL only supports pctOfCasterMaxHp / flat amount; start_of_turn fires for the actor's own passive, not on other allies' turns)
increases the RES of allies under [Veil]/[Perfect Veil] by 50 (flat) — [Increase RES] has no engine consumer (no res in STAT_MODS); placing it would be inert
'Will only increase RES once per ally if there are multiple Rectors on the team' — de-dup clause, no-op with a single Rector

newOpsNeeded.why: Rector passive heals a veiled ally on THAT ally's own turn for 10% of the ally's own MAX HP — needs a cross-ally turn trigger (event fires on any ally's turn, not the passive owner's) gated on the moving ally being under [Veil]/[Perfect Veil], plus a HEAL variant that scales off the target ally's MAX HP rather than the caster's
Rector A3 places [Perfect Veil] on the single ally it just revived — no recipient enum resolves to the just-revived ally (recurring gap on revive-then-buff skills)

Rector A2 places [Perfect Veil] on full-HP allies vs a 15% [Continuous Heal] on below-full allies after an AoE heal — needs a per-recipient HP-fraction branch (allies_full_hp / allies_below_full_hp) for buff placement

notes: Source of truth: step3-champions.json "Rector Drath" (Knights Revenant / Force / Epic / Support; base HP 21615). All 4 skills decomposed; every clause is either an action or a named deferred entry (no silent drops). A1 fully modelled (attack + Decrease ATK, a registered consumer). A2 models only the 20% MAX-HP AoE heal (multiplier 0.2 / multiplierType HP = the heal, NOT damage — no DEAL_DAMAGE); the post-heal Perfect Veil / Continuous Heal split is deferred solely because it is per-ally conditional on post-heal HP fraction. A3 models the single-ally revive (60% HP + 60% TM); the Perfect Veil on the revived ally is deferred on the known revived_ally-recipient gap. Passive is entirely deferred: its heal needs an ally-turn trigger + target-MaxHP heal, and the +50 RES is inert (no consumer). No damage multiplier was fabricated — F_RECTOR_A1 uses the DB value (ATK x4, 1 hit); A2/A3 produce no attack so no formula.

recipes.name: Tremor Staff
covers: AoE 2.4xATK on all enemies (F_GEOMANCER_A1)
50% [Decrease ACC] 2t @30% on all enemies (consumed by engine)

recipes.name: Creeping Petrify
covers: attacks 1 enemy 6xATK (F_GEOMANCER_A2)
removes all buffs from the target (BUFF_STRIP, default branch)
steals all buffs INSTEAD if the target is under a [HP Burn] placed by this Champion (STEAL_BUFF, gated under_debuff HP Burn — runs before the strip so the strip is a no-op when the steal fires)
deferred: '[HP Burn] placed by THIS Champion' provenance is not tracked — the under_debuff condition matches ANY [HP Burn] on the target regardless of who placed it (minor over-credit; Geomancer supplies her own HP Burn via A3)

if the interpreter does not honour a 'condition' on STEAL_BUFF (STEAL_BUFF 'acts on the acquired enemy set'), the steal would fire unconditionally rather than only when the target is under [HP Burn] — condition-gating of STEAL_BUFF unconfirmed

'Reduces the cooldown of Quicksand Grasp (A3) by 2 turns if the target is killed by this Skill while under a [HP Burn] debuff placed by this Champion' — kill-conditional self-cooldown reduction gated on (target died this skill) AND (target under this-champ [HP Burn]); no on-kill + under-debuff trigger for a self DECREASE_COOLDOWN — needs op

recipes.name: Quicksand Grasp
covers: fully depletes the target's Turn Meter AND fills this Champion's Turn Meter by the amount the target loses (STEAL_TURN_METER pct 1.0)
[HP Burn] 3t @75% on the target (consumed; scales off target MAX HP, DEF-independent)
deferred: 25% [Weaken] 3t on the target — [Weaken] has no engine consumer (not in CONSUMED_EFFECTS/consumer registry); placing it would be inert
in-game the [HP Burn] and the [Weaken] share ONE 75% placement roll; modelled as a single 75% HP Burn roll (Weaken deferred anyway), identical in EV
no damage multiplier in DB (multiplier=null, multiplierType=null) — the skill does not attack, so DEAL_DAMAGE is correctly omitted (nothing fabricated)

recipes.name: Stoneguard [P]
deferred: Decreases the damage all allies receive by 15% AND deflects that mitigated damage onto each enemy under a [HP Burn] debuff placed by this Champion — party-wide always-on incoming-damage-reduction aura whose absorbed damage is redistributed as an attack onto HP-Burned enemies; no op for a mitigation-aura-with-deflect — needs op: DAMAGE_DEFLECT_AURA

Whenever this Champion is attacked, deflects 30% of the damage instead (vs the 15% party aura) — self-only on-attacked deflect magnitude override; part of the same unbuilt DAMAGE_DEFLECT_AURA / reflect mechanic (no 'attacked'->deflect op)

When deflecting damage, on each enemy hit has a 30% chance of dealing additional damage equal to 3% of the target's MAX HP — per-deflect-hit %MAX-HP rider (DEF-independent) with no host op (depends on the unbuilt deflect); needs op

'If multiple Champions on the team have this skill, only one activates' / 'will not activate on duplicate copies of this Champion if this particular Champion is dead' — single-copy dedup + dead-original disable not modelled (single Geomancer on a team -> no-op)

newOpsNeeded.why: Geomancer Passive (Stoneguard): a party-wide always-on incoming-damage reduction (15% for allies, 30% for herself when attacked) that REDIRECTS the mitigated damage as an attack onto every enemy under a [HP Burn] placed by this Champion, with a 30%-per-hit rider of +3% target MAX HP damage. No existing op expresses a mitigation aura whose absorbed damage is deflected onto DoT-flagged enemies (REDIRECT_DAMAGE/reflect are implemented:false).

Geomancer A2 (Creeping Petrify): reduce the cooldown of a named own skill (A3) by 2 turns ONLY if the target is killed by this skill WHILE under a [HP Burn] placed by this Champion. Requires an on-kill trigger compounded with an under-debuff (self-provenance) condition driving a self DECREASE_COOLDOWN; no such gated trigger exists.

notes: Geomancer — Force / Epic / Attack / Dwarves. recipeKey prefix GEOMANCER. A1 (2.4xATK AoE) and A2 (6xATK single) fully modelled bar A2's kill-conditional cooldown branch. A3 has NO damage multiplier in the DB and does not attack — it is a pure TM-steal + HP Burn placer, so STEAL_TURN_METER(pct 1.0) captures both the full-deplete and the caster-refill in one op; DEAL_DAMAGE correctly omitted (nothing fabricated). A2's buff branch modelled as STEAL_BUFF (gated under_debuff HP Burn) ordered before an unconditional BUFF_STRIP so the strip is a no-op when the steal fires (not_under_debuff is not a supported condition kind, so this ordering reproduces the 'steals instead' semantics without double-crediting). Consumer check: Decrease ACC and HP Burn are in the registry (consumed); [Weaken] on A3 is inert and deferred. The entire Passive is deferred — a mitigation-aura-with-deflect with no engine op; flagged as newOpsNeeded DAMAGE_DEFLECT_AURA. Formulas F_GEOMANCER_A1 (2.4) and F_GEOMANCER_A2 (6) use verbatim DB multipliers, ATK scaling, standard DMG_FLAGS.

notes:
Visix (Legendary, Void, Defense, Dark Elves; base DEF 1476, HP 17175, SPD 97) is a defensive DEF-scaling protector. Every clause maps to an implemented op — no new ops needed. Recipes belong in lib/sim/recipes.js RECIPES map, keyed VISIX-*; add F_VISIX_A1 to the FORMULAS map with flags: { ...DMG_FLAGS } (the formulas payload emits the literal string '...DMG_FLAGS' as a placeholder for that spread).

Per-skill:
- A1 Single Combat (DEF 4.1, cd 0): F_VISIX_A1 attack + 75% [Decrease Turn Meter] 15%. REDUCE_TURN_METER honours effect.chance (interpreter.js:643) and effect.accuracy_check (:652) — TM decrease is RES-resistable, so accuracy_check:true is faithful.
- A2 Sinister Ally (cd 3): DISCREPANCY — DB stores a 3.5 DEF damage_multiplier, but the verbatim summary contains NO attack clause (only two buff placements). Working strictly from verbatim text (do not invent effects), I modelled only the two buffs and deferred the stray multiplier rather than fabricating an attack. [Ally Protection] + [Taunt] both in consumer registry.
- A3 Gruesome Flurry (multiplier null, cd 3): AoE attack with no DB multiplier → DEAL_DAMAGE omitted + deferred; ACQUIRE_TARGETS all_enemies still runs so [Decrease Speed] (guaranteed — no chance stated) and 75% [Provoke] land on intended_set. Both consumed.
- Passive Unbowed: start_of_turn self-heal 10% MaxHP → start_of_turn trigger + HEAL (TRIGGER_OP_HANDLERS.HEAL heals the owner). The tank seat's self-sustain.

recipes.name: Harassment Volley
covers: 3 hits ATK x1.5 single target
deferred: Each critical hit has an 80% chance of stealing 5% of the target's Turn Meter — needs op: onHitStealTurnMeter (per-hit, crit-conditional rider). STEAL_TURN_METER op exists but only fires once per skill and cannot gate on a per-hit crit; no rider hook on the DEAL_DAMAGE hit loop for it.

recipes.name: No Respite
covers: Decrease DEF 60% 2t (per-hit 50%, via F_RUELLA_A2.onHitPlaceDebuff)
Decrease SPD 30% 2t @50%
deferred: [Weaken] 25% 2t — no engine consumer (Weaken not in Consumer Registry) — inert

In-game each of the 3 hits rolls ONE shared 50% to place all three debuffs; Decrease DEF is modelled per-hit (rider, ~1-0.5^3 land) but Decrease SPD is modelled as a single 50% placement per skill (only one per-hit rider slot exists) — under-models Decrease SPD land probability

Increase C.RATE 30% on all allies 2t

newOpsNeeded.why: Ruella A1: each of 3 hits, on a critical hit, has an 80% chance to steal 5% of the target's Turn Meter. Needs a per-hit, crit-conditional turn-meter-steal rider on the DEAL_DAMAGE hit loop (mirror of onHitPlaceDebuff). The standalone STEAL_TURN_METER op fires once per skill and has no crit gate, so it cannot represent this per-hit-on-crit cadence.

notes: Ruella (Epic, Spirit, Attack, Sylvan Watchers). A1 Harassment Volley (cd0, 3x1.5 ATK) — damage modelled; the per-hit crit-conditional 5% TM steal is deferred (needs onHitStealTurnMeter rider). A2 No Respite (cd4, 3x2.3 ATK) — Decrease DEF placed per-hit via the formula onHitPlaceDebuff rider (precedent: Stag A1 / Ninja A2 / Vallaryn A1), Decrease SPD placed via an after_hit PLACE_DEBUFF (single 50% roll, cadence-approximated), [Weaken] deferred as inert (no consumer). A3 Timed Offensive (cd6) — FILL_TURN_METER all_allies 0.20 (pct is a FRACTION per the doFillTurnMeter x100 convention) + Increase C.RATE 30% 2t on all allies; both fully modelled. No passive. All damage multipliers taken verbatim from the DB (A1 1.5, A2 2.3, both ATK); A3 has no multiplier and does not attack.

recipes.name: Skull Comet

formulas.note: DB multiplier 1.1 ATK. 'Attacks 3 times at random' -> hitCount 3 + randomTargetPerHit. 'Each hit has a 30% chance of [Freeze] 1t' -> per-hit rider (each of the 3 random hits rolls its own Freeze), same pattern as F_NINJA_A2 / F_COLDHEART_A1. flags = {...DMG_FLAGS}.

DB multiplier 1.35 ATK. 'Attacks 1 enemy 4 times' -> hitCount 4. Debuffs differ by hit INDEX (hits 1&2 = Decrease ATK, hits 3&4 = Decrease ACC), which onHitPlaceDebuff (uniform across all hits) cannot express, so NO rider on the formula -- the two debuffs are placed via PLACE_DEBUFF actions in the recipe. flags = {...DMG_FLAGS}.

DB multiplier 1.8 ATK. 'Attacks all enemies 2 times' -> hitCount 2 (AoE via ACQUIRE all_enemies). 'Each hit has a 50% chance of 30% [Decrease SPD] 2t' -> per-hit rider (each of the 2 hits rolls its own). 'Heals this Champion by 30% of the damage dealt' -> selfHealPctOfDamage 0.30 (as F_GNUT_A3 / F_HORDIN_A2). flags = {...DMG_FLAGS}.

scope 'an ALLY places [Freeze]': enemy_frozen fires on ANY enemy Freeze, INCLUDING those this Champion places with her own A1. Whether the card's 'ally' includes self is ambiguous; modelled as inclusive (self counts). Minor over-credit if self-freezes are meant to be excluded (and a self-chain A1-Freeze -> passive-A1 -> Freeze is possible, which is game-accurate for a chaining reactive).

newOpsNeeded.why: Neldor A2 places a DIFFERENT debuff on different hit indices (hits 1&2 = Decrease ATK, hits 3&4 = Decrease ACC). The current onHitPlaceDebuff formula rider is uniform across all hits, so hit-index-specific riders cannot be expressed; A2 was approximated with two combined-chance PLACE_DEBUFF actions (0.75 each). A per-hit-index rider spec (e.g. onHitPlaceDebuffByHit) would restore per-hit fidelity.

newOpsNeeded.why: Neldor's passive is a 30% chance to counterattack on enemy_frozen. Confirm the enemy_frozen -> COUNTERATTACK dispatch honours a per-action `chance` field; if not, a probabilistic reactive attack cannot be modelled without over-crediting (fires at 100%).

notes: All four skills modelled with existing ops -- no clause dropped. Multipliers verbatim from DB (A1 1.1, A2 1.35, A3 1.8, all ATK); A1 cd null->0. Consumer-registry tokens: Freeze (A1, hard CC), Decrease Attack + Decrease ACC (A2), Decrease Speed (A3) -- all consumed. Two modeling approximations, both flagged in deferred + newOpsNeeded: (1) A2's per-hit-INDEX debuffs collapsed to single 0.75 PLACE_DEBUFFs (=1-(1-0.5)^2); (2) passive's 30% gate rides the trigger action's `chance` and A3's per-hit rider assumes AoE application. Passive uses the proven HILVI-PASSIVE enemy_frozen trigger surface with COUNTERATTACK(slot A1, target attacker). Recommend running tools/sim-suite.mjs to confirm the enemy_frozen->COUNTERATTACK chance and AoE onHitPlaceDebuff behaviours in the interpreter.
